title: Discord Bot — Gateway, Commands & Features
description: Gateway health, Discord REST rate limits, slash commands, and the features that run outside commands.

panels.title: Gateway availability (range)
panels.description: Share of samples in the selected range with the gateway connected. This is the real uptime figure; the SLO 'uptime_30d' gauge is a command-success proxy.

panels.title: Discord.NET log events
panels.description: Per minute, by severity. Warnings and errors here are Discord.NET's own (reconnects, rate limits, gateway faults).

panels.title: REST responses by route (top 10)
panels.description: From Discord.NET's rate-limit callback, one per REST response. Snowflakes and tokens are collapsed in the route.

panels.title: Rate limits
panels.description: Per minute. hit = a 429 from Discord; exhausted = a bucket reached 0 remaining and Discord.NET waited.

targets.expr: sum by (command) (increase(discordbot_command_count_total{service_name="discordbot", deployment_environment=~"$env", service_instance_id=~"$instance", status="failure"}[$__range])) / sum by (command) (increase(discordbot_command_count_total{service_name="discordbot", deployment_environment=~"$env", service_instance_id=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Command rate-limit violations / min
panels.description: Users hitting the bot's own per-command rate limits (not Discord's).
